entry_item.definition: n. Head (anat and fig.); top, tip; hillock, knoll, mound; head of cattle (classifier in counting); piece of material; initial syllable of a Mongolian word.

example.definition: A matter on which one's life depends, a matter of life and death
To feel a buzzing int he head; to be stunned.
To be dizzy, giddy; to lose one's wits.
To follow one's whims; to act on one's own responsibility, independently
At the moment of one's departure
Ear, spike, or head of grain.
Bull's head; white sandalwood, Santalum album.

entry_item.definition: n. The head. The top. An ear of grain. A chief.

example.definition: To turn the head. To be dizzy. To get giddiness. To be bewildered.

† цагаан толгой азбука, букварь.
II 1) кусок, штука; толгой бараа кусок, пачка товара; толгой бөс кусок материи; нэг толгой чисчүү одљн кусок чесучљ (ткань); 2) пачка; толгой лаа пачка свечей.
